statement: The function returns a result r. For each integer v, let occ(nums,v) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v. Then r is the sum of all integers v such that occ(nums,v) = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.
